definitions.explanation: A person one has known for a long time, or the relationship of having known someone for many years. A somewhat literary or formal word.

examples.english: He and I are old acquaintances.

examples.japanese: {旧知|きゅうち}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{友人|ゆうじん}→友人：03649_yuujin⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{久|ひさ}しぶり→久しぶり：01711_hisashiburi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{再会|さいかい}→再会：11667_saikai⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I reunited with an old friend after a long time.

examples.japanese: ⟦{二人|ふたり}→二人：00622_futari⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{旧知|きゅうち}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{間柄|あいだがら}→間柄：19442_aidagara⟧で、⟦{学生|がくせい}→学生：00610_gakusei⟧⟦{時代|じだい}→時代：01424_jidai⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{付|つ}き{合|あ}い→付き合い：03520_tsukiai⟧だ⟦という→という：09577_toiu⟧。
examples.english: The two are old acquaintances, having been friends since their student days.

notes:
A formal or literary word for a long-standing acquaintance or friendship. Composed of ⟦{旧|きゅう}→旧：19346_kyuu⟧ (old/former) + {知|ち} (knowing/acquaintance). Often appears in set phrases like {旧知|きゅうち}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{仲|なか}→仲：09513_naka⟧ or {旧知|きゅうち}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{間柄|あいだがら}→間柄：19442_aidagara⟧.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {旧知|きゅうち}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{仲|なか}→仲：09513_naka⟧: an old acquaintanceship
- {旧知|きゅうち}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{間柄|あいだがら}→間柄：19442_aidagara⟧: a long-standing relationship
- {旧知|きゅうち}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{友人|ゆうじん}→友人：03649_yuujin⟧: an old friend
- {旧知|きゅうち}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{温|あたた}める→温める：02096_atatameru⟧: to renew an old friendship

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{知|し}り{合|あ}い→知り合い：03253_shiriai⟧: acquaintance — everyday word, no implication of length
- ⟦{旧友|きゅうゆう}→旧友：17475_kyuuyuu⟧: old friend — specifically a friend, not just an acquaintance
- ⟦{幼馴染|おさななじみ}→幼馴染：12429_osananajimi⟧: childhood friend — friends since childhood specifically
- ⟦{顔見知|かおみし}り→顔見知り：06834_kaomishiri⟧: someone one knows by face — casual and superficial acquaintance

REGISTER:
Formal and slightly literary. More common in written Japanese, news, and formal speech than in casual conversation.
